# NVDA research brief: % change from the 2026-08-21 close to the 2026-09-21 close

Many search results contained information from after 2026-08-24, including earnings results, post-earnings price moves and the September Fed decision. I left all of it out as instructed. Everything below is dated on or before 2026-08-24, or is a schedule that was already known by then.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-21: The NVDA close on Yahoo Finance was **$214.72**, the baseline figure from the code-collected data. Ticker NVDA trades on Nasdaq and the question uses the regular daily close.
- I could not fetch Yahoo Finance directly. Third-party reports of closes line up with the baseline: about $225.01 on 2026-08-17 and $216.85 on 2026-08-20. [roic.ai](https://www.roic.ai/news/nvidia-falls-for-7th-day-longest-losing-streak-since-2022-08-24-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The biggest single scheduled catalyst, fiscal Q2 2027 earnings, comes after the forecast deadline.
- 2026-08-21: NVDA was on a multi-day losing streak going into the baseline date. Reports describe about $204B in market value lost over five days, with a sixth straight drop looming. [thecryptobasic](https://thecryptobasic.com/2026/08/21/nvidia-loses-204-billion-in-five-days-as-sixth-straight-drop-looms-before-earnings/)
- 2026-08-24: Coverage dated that day says the stock fell about 2.9% intraday for a 7th straight losing session, its longest streak since 2022, as tech pulled back. [roic.ai](https://www.roic.ai/news/nvidia-falls-for-7th-day-longest-losing-streak-since-2022-08-24-2026) If that held at the close, NVDA would be at about $208.5, roughly -2.9% against the baseline. That is an intraday report and I could not confirm the closing price.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: The decline was put down to rising Treasury yields hitting high-valuation tech and caution ahead of earnings. Some reports also cite a 15% price hike for some chip customers, US-Canada tariff threats, Iran sanctions and criticism of "circular financing". [roic.ai](https://www.roic.ai/news/nvidia-falls-for-7th-day-longest-losing-streak-since-2022-08-24-2026); [beincrypto](https://beincrypto.com/nvidia-stock-losing-streak-earnings/)
- 2026-08-24: A Motley Fool piece reviewed how the stock has moved after past earnings reports. [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/24/will-nvidia-stock-soar-after-aug-26-here-s-what-history-shows/)
- 2026-08-21: CNBC's preview of the week said it would bring PCE data, Nvidia earnings and Jackson Hole, and that tech had been a notable loser. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-aug-24-28-2026.html)
- 2026-08-21: A Motley Fool piece made a bullish case tied to the earnings report. [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/21/prediction-nvidia-stock-will-go-parabolic-after-aug-26-here-are-2-3-trillion-reasons-why/)
- 2026-08-17: Nvidia filed an 8-K, likely the earnings date announcement. [SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000069/nvda-20260817.htm)
- About 2026-08-10: Some reports trace the start of the slide to a roughly $500B financing plan with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR. [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nvidia-longest-losing-streak-five-years/)
- Pre-earnings consensus:
  - Fiscal Q2 revenue of about $91.8B and EPS of about $2.08-2.09. Nvidia's own guidance was $91B ±2%.
  - The Street expected about $104B for fiscal Q3 revenue.
  - Nvidia had beaten estimates 13 quarters in a row.
  - The stock fell the day after each of the previous four reports.
  - Bank of America's price target was $350, and all 26 analysts on TipRanks rated it Buy.
  - [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/live/nvidia-earnings-live-updates-and-commentary-august-2026); [beincrypto](https://beincrypto.com/nvidia-stock-losing-streak-earnings/)

## 4. Base rates
- The code baseline gives an empirical 21-day price distribution. Expressed as % change from $214.72:

| Percentile | Price | Change |
|---|---|---|
| p5 | $189.29 | -11.8% |
| p10 | $195.67 | -8.9% |
| p25 | $208.57 | -2.9% |
| p50 | $220.65 | +2.8% |
| p75 | $238.23 | +11.0% |
| p90 | $259.26 | +20.7% |
| p95 | $274.26 | +27.7% |

- The p25-p75 range is about 14 percentage points wide.
- This window includes an earnings report. NVDA's next-day moves after earnings have historically been about ±3% to ±10%, and the post-report move has often been negative even on beats (four in a row before this report).
- Up to 2026-08-25 the stock was still up more than 13% year to date despite the streak. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/24/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)
- September has historically been a seasonally weak month for equities and semiconductors.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket ran NVDA "close above" markets for late August 2026. [polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/nvda-above-in-august-2026) The snapshots I found were from mirror sites with unclear dates and possibly post-earnings, so I could not get reliable pre-deadline prices.
- I could not find a pre-earnings options implied move. Historically it has been around ±6-7%.
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market covering the 2026-09-21 date.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-26 (Wed, after the close): Nvidia fiscal Q2 2027 earnings and Q3 guidance, the main catalyst. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/nvda-20260826.htm)
- Week of 2026-08-24: PCE inflation data, then the Jackson Hole symposium. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/21/stock-market-next-week-outlook-for-aug-24-28-2026.html)
- Around 2026-09-04: August jobs report. Around 2026-09-10/11: CPI. These dates are typical, not confirmed.
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting, with projections and the dot plot. [fedratecalc](https://fedratecalc.com/fomc-meeting-schedule/september-2026/)
- 2026-09-18: Quarterly options expiration ("quad witching"), a typical date I did not confirm.
- Ongoing: US-China export and tariff news (Nvidia's guidance excludes China data center sales), Treasury yields and AI capex headlines.
